title.en: Tale 16 — The Gazelle in the Trap

sentences.en: One day, the gazelle was late and did not return.

sentences.ar: الغراب طار ودور عليها من فوق.
sentences.en: The crow flew and searched for her from above.
He found her caught in a hunter’s trap.

sentences.ar: رجع وجاب الفار، والفار قص الحبال.
sentences.en: He went back and brought the mouse, and the mouse cut the ropes.

sentences.ar: بس السلحفاة إجت مشي وهي بطيئة.
sentences.en: But the tortoise came walking, and she is slow.
The hunter arrived and caught the tortoise.

sentences.ar: عملوا خطة: الغزالة عملت حالها عرجا.
sentences.en: They made a plan: the gazelle pretended to be lame.
The hunter ran after her and left the tortoise.
Those who have friends are not lost.
